content.text: Some users want to enforce that checkpoint commits are always signed. That feature is current working on a "best effort basis". Add a new setting that enable users to opt into failing in case Entire can't sign a checkpoint.
I’ll trace where checkpoint commits are created and where signing is currently treated as best effort, then add the setting through the existing settings package and command surface.

The code already has `sign_checkpoint_commits`, defaulting to enabled, and a `SignCommitBestEffort` path. I’m narrowing this to the signing helper, committed checkpoint writer, and settings merge/update code so the new option fits the existing config model.
